title: unified-rollouts: canary + shadow + A/B + automated-rollback workflow
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Add unified rollout workflow that combines canary, A/B, and shadow traffic with configurable automated rollback policies and observability hooks.
description: Motivation: Operators need a single, configurable rollout workflow that supports canary, A/B, and shadow traffic modes with automated rollback driven by composite and quarantine metrics. This PR implements a unified rollout orchestration path that reduces duplication between canary and shadow flows and adds safety guards for noisy telemetry. Summary of changes: - New unified controller that coordinates staged canary, weighted A/B, and shadow probing phases. - Automated rollback engine: supports composite metrics, quorum-based metric voting, and quarantine stage, and configurable grace periods. - Observability: new rollout metrics, telemetry tags, and tracing spans for rollout decisions. - E2E tests and stability guards to prevent flapping in low-signal workloads. - Docs and API: rollout policy CRD updates and examples. Checklist: - [x] Design doc (Linear ENG-1428) reviewed - [x] Implementation of controller and autorollback engine - [x] Unit tests for policy evaluation logic - [x] Integration tests for canary + shadow interactions - [x] E2E tests using test harness (perf-canary) - [x] Documentation and example rollout YAML What changed (high-level): - pkg/rollouts/controller.go: unified orchestration loop, state machine for stages (preflight -> canary -> staged-shadow -> weighted-ab -> promote/quarantine/rollback). - pkg/rollouts/autorollback.go: new autorollback engine supporting composite-metrics, quorum voting, and quarantine transitions. - runtime/router/traffic_router.go: routing updates to support concurrent shadow traffic and canary weighting without double-counting metrics. - telemetry/metrics.go: added rollout decision metrics (rollout.stage_changed, rollout.votes, rollout.quarantine_entered) and tags to correlate with model versions and routes. - e2e/rollouts/: new end-to-end tests validating staged shadow probing and rollback safety guards. - docs/reference/rollouts.md: updated policy examples and migration notes. Commits: - "unified-rollouts: add controller skeleton and state machine" - "autorollback: implement composite metric quorum and quarantine handling" - "router: support shadow-only requests and canary weight adjustments" - "telemetry: emit rollout decision metrics and traces" - "tests: add e2e scenarios and stability guards" - "docs: rollout policy examples and migration notes" Testing and CI: - Ran unit tests and integration tests locally; CI initially failed on flaky e2e test (timeout in shadow probe) - Reworked probe timeout handling and retried CI; all checks now pass (build & unit & e2e & lint). Observability & rollout safety: - Default policy includes a quarantine stage where a failing canary can be quarantined for manual review instead of immediate rollback when signal is low-confidence. - Composite metric support allows customers to provide multiple metrics (latency, error-rate, model-quality) with weighted thresholds. - Quorum voting requires a configurable percentage of metrics to cross thresholds before an automatic rollback triggers. Migration notes: - Existing rollout policies will continue to work; small schema change for policy.conditions (added optional "quorum" field). Migration tooling converts old policies with default quorum=0.8. - We add a deprecation note for legacy shadow-only workflow flags; operators should migrate to the unified policy CRD to get autorollback safety guards. Rollout plan: - Feature gated behind rollout.unified.enabled feature flag (defaults to false). - Short canary on staging for 24h, then promote to production with a 10% weighted A/B stage and staged shadow probing. - Monitor rollout.votes, rollout.quarantine_entered, and per-route model quality metrics for first 72h. Notes for reviewers: - Focus review on autorollback quorum logic and state transitions (quarantine vs immediate rollback). - Look for edge cases where a model switch could cause double counting in metrics when shadow and canary traffic overlap. - Security: no new permission surfaces; controller runs with existing rollout RBAC. Related: ENG-1428 (design), SUP-4021 (customer incident that motivated quarantine stage).
